Only subtle Live2D-style motion: gentle breathing, tiny armor/fin sway, cyan spear crystal glint, soft ocean resonance shimmer. Preserve identity: big purple eyes, glossy pink skin, teal scalloped shell armor with chest clam shell, single cyan trident. Transparent background, generous safe margins, no text, no UI, no extra characters, no crop. Frame 16 must loop cleanly back to frame 1.
